entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return something. I've been on hold forever and I'm losing my patience. This is ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear about the wait time. I can definitely help you with a return. To get started, can you tell me the item you're calling about and what specifically is the issue?

It's the helmet I bought. The issue is that I don't want it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the picture. The box is unopened, still sealed. I want my money back, and I want it now.
Okay, I understand. Just to be perfectly clear, the return is due to a preference with the color, and not a technical fault or any concern about its safety features, is that right?
What are you not getting? YES, it's the color! This is unbelievable. I want to speak to your manager. This whole process is a scam. I'm about to leave a review that will sink your company.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you, speaking to a manager won't be necessary. I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account and review the policy... Okay, I see your order. The helmet was delivered 32 days ago.
And? So what? It's a brand new item. I told you the box is unopened!

You are absolutely correct. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items. Since the helmet is in its original condition, I can approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... why didn't you just say so? Okay, fine. That's all I needed. Just process the return.

Of course. I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Good. That's what you should have done in the first place.
I appreciate your patience. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
